hero.lead: Unique instrumental tracks, composed and synthesised in real time by algorithm. No vocals: music theory, synths, royalty-free sampled instruments (CC0) and a seed.
hero.pipe1.d: Scale, mode and chord progression drawn from the seed.
hero.pipe2.d: Markov-chain melody, bass, drums, sectional arrangement.
hero.pipe3.d: Oscillators, FM, plucked strings, reverb, mastering.
create.styleHint: Each style has its own scales, chord progressions, grooves and synths.
create.aiState: describe the mood — AI fills in the rest
create.aiPlaceholder: e.g. a night in Paris, filtered funky bass, a bit dirty like Justice, building slowly…
create.aiMeta: Title, description and tags FR + EN
create.title: Title
create.mixRelated: Allow nearby styles in the mix
create.formatsHint: MP3 and MIDI (full + per-instrument ZIP) are always produced.
create.splitMid: Cut in the middle of transitions
create.splitLib: Add each track to the library
create.splitHint: For generations over 30 min: when rendering finishes, each sub-track becomes a file (WAV, MP3, MIDI) named “01 - Title”, downloadable as a ZIP from the library (“Tracks” button). With “One YouTube video per track”, each piece also gets its video (animation, layout and YouTube panel language). You can also do this later.
create.advHint: Fields show the values this style will actually use with this seed. Change one: it turns green and is remembered for this style (↺ to restore the style value). Settings are saved with the track and reused by “Variation”.
create.genHint: Generation takes a few seconds on the server.
lib.title: Library
player.zipTitle: One MIDI file per instrument + the full track
admin.nodesHint: Videos go to the best free node: NVIDIA PC (NVENC) first, then Apple Silicon Mac (VideoToolbox), then libx264, then the CT as fallback. If a node drops mid-render, the video moves to another node or the CT. Since v1.16.0, a 1.16+ agent also renders audio (same engine as the CT, bit-identical); v1.17.0 adds the Mac mini (VideoToolbox).
admin.nodeTokenOpt: optional, if the agent requires one
admin.forceHint: All videos go to this node. If it is offline, the CT takes over.
admin.pcComboHint: Option “Render audio and video together on the PC / Mac” (Generate form): whatever the duration, audio is rendered on the node (Windows NVIDIA PC or Apple Silicon Mac) then the long video is encoded there immediately, without waiting for the CT; the single ZIP (video, mix MP3 + WAV, tracks, MIDI, samples) is ready to download at the end. If the node drops, the CT resumes (audio or video) and the status says so.
admin.aiHint: Powers the art director (Generate → “Describe the mood”) and trend watch. Without a reachable AI PC: local suggestions.
toast.aiNeedPrompt: Describe the mood in a few words.
toast.advReset: Advanced settings for this style reset.
toast.regen: Regenerating “{title}”: same seed, corrected harmony. The original is kept.
toast.settingsLoaded: Settings reloaded: same seed + same settings = same track.
toast.brandOff: No name on thumbnails and videos. Thumbnail regenerated.
toast.brandOn: Display name: “{text}”. Thumbnail regenerated; recreate the video to see it there.
